items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Sometimes, blah, stop there and talk to him sometimes. Plenty of times.

ctx.x: Sometimes he stutters. Yeah, right. Yeah. Other times, though, he doesn't stutter much. Much, yeah. When he talked for us, for Trulaine in the interview, he didn't stutter very much. No, no. No, came right out. Were you there or not?

I believe it's quite natural, you know. I think it's like that, you know, if you're interviewing or anything like that, it looks like you holds up on that, or you call it stut. Right, please. I think that's the way it is. Sometimes, blah, stop there and talk to him sometimes. Plenty of times.
Do you remember anything about Baby Dodds, the drummer, when he got his instrument? Do you remember when he started playing? Was he playing when he was working?
